description: Cancels a scheduled call the authenticated user organizes, and takes it off invitees' calendars. For a recurring call, scope and occurrence_start_time pick the occurrences: all of them (the default), one, or one and every one after it. Cancelling what is already cancelled succeeds.

notify_invitees.description: Whether invitees get an email about it. Defaults to true.

occurrence_start_time.description: Start of the occurrence that scope this or this_and_following refers to (RFC 3339).

scope.description: Which occurrences: all (the default without occurrence_start_time), this (the default with it), o...
